title: Quick Energizing Filipino Fideo Bicol Express
description: A herbal and springy Filipino dish featuring fideo, broil, and jain-friendly ingredients, inspired by the flavors of Bicol Express
instructions: Cook the fideo noodles according to package instructions and set aside
In a large pot, combine coconut milk, vegetable broth, and bruised lemongrass
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes
Add cubed silken tofu, sliced green chili peppers, and chopped Thai basil to the pot
Season with salt and black pepper to taste
Simmer the mixture for an additional 5 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together
Add cooked fideo noodles to the pot and stir to combine
Serve the Quick Energizing Filipino Fideo Bicol Express hot, garnished with additional Thai basil if desired
